scripts.test:cross: CROSS_BROWSER=1 PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_VALIDATE_HOST_REQUIREMENTS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pw-libs/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/cross-browser.spec.js tests/cross-device.spec.js
scripts.docs:shots: npm run docs:shots:light && npm run docs:shots:dark
scripts.docs:shots:light: CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=light WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js
scripts.docs:shots:dark: CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=dark  WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js
scripts.docs:shots:participant: CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=light WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g participant && CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=dark WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g participant
scripts.docs:shots:admin: CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=light WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g admin       && CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=dark WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g admin
scripts.docs:shots:event-admin: CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=light WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g event-admin && CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=dark WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g event-admin
scripts.docs:shots:superadmin: CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=light WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g superadmin  && CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 THEME=dark WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_screenshots.spec.js -g superadmin
scripts.polish:shots: CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 WORKERS=1 RETRIES=0 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/_ui-polish.spec.js
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf .coverage && HACKARENA_COVERAGE=.coverage NODE_V8_COVERAGE=.coverage/worker playwright test; node scripts/coverage-report.cjs
